verdict.rationale: Decagon ships built-in assistants for operators. Duet can generate Agent Operating Procedures from past conversations, generate QA tests, and automatically iterate on the agent. Ask AI answers open-ended analytical questions about customer conversations in natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth documentation of how tasks are handed to Duet and reviewed, and evidence of general-purpose delegation beyond agent-building and analytics.
